title: Driving through safety zone prohibited
text: No vehicle shall at any time be driven through or within a safety zone.

title: Limitations on backing (1)
text: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back the vehicle unless such movement can be made with reasonable safety and without interfering with other traffic.

title: Limitations on backing (2)
text: The driver of a vehicle: Shall not back into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner.

title: One-way highway (1)
text: Upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic a vehicle shall be driven only in the direction designated.

title: One-way highway (2)
text: A vehicle passing around a rotary traffic island shall be driven only to the right of such island.

title: Vehicle entering highway from private way
text: The driver of a vehicle about to enter or cross a highway from a private way shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on such highway.

title: Direction of movement on crosswalk
text: Pedestrians shall move whenever practicable upon the right half of crosswalks.

title: Maximum speed of school bus (1)
text: A school bus shall not exceed: A speed of 55 miles per hour when transporting pupils to and from school.

title: Basic rule (1)(e)
text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: In any event, a rate of speed greater than 80 miles per hour.

title: Position of driver’s hands
text: The driver of a motorcycle or moped shall drive with at least one hand on a handlebar at all times.
